# dsh-tool-gitlab
English | 中文
A Cordis tool plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) enterprise-grade GitLab capabilities. Agent
s can review merge requests end-to-end (changes, discussions, approvals), observe and trigger CI/CD
pipelines, audit group/project membership, and work their personal todo inbox — in natural language.
Built on the official "everything is a plugin" architecture via `ctx.tools.register(defineTool(...))
`, following the official adding-a-tool contract. Designed for **self-managed GitLab** (`baseUrl` ov
erride) and **enterprise governance workflows**.
